title: unit upgrades: core formulas, smithy service, combat integration
criteria:
Implement smithy unit upgrades (T22). Config section `cfg.upgrades` (UpgradesSection: bonus_per_level 0.015, max_level 20, cost_unit_multiple 10, cost_growth 1.3, time_base_s 1800, time_growth 1.2, unit_types ['inf','cav','siege']) and the model `realm.db.models.UnitUpgrade(village_id, unit, level, upgrading_to, finishes_at)` already exist. EDITING RULE: realm/services/military.py, realm/services/views.py, realm/core/units.py and realm/core/combat.py must be changed with small targeted Edit operations ONLY (never rewrite them as whole files: they contain proofread Thai strings that must stay byte-identical). New code for services goes into the NEW file realm/services/smithy.py.

== realm/core/units.py (append / small edits) ==
`upgrade_multiplier(level, cfg) -> float` = 1 + cfg.upgrades.bonus_per_level * level; `can_upgrade(unit, cfg) -> bool` (cfg.units[unit].type in cfg.upgrades.unit_types); `upgrade_cost(unit, tribe, target_level, cfg) -> Res` = unit_cost(unit, tribe, cfg) * cfg.upgrades.cost_unit_multiple * cost_growth ** (target_level - 1), each resource floored with math.floor(x + 1e-9) (avoid float noise); `upgrade_time_s(target_level, speed, cfg) -> float` = max(1.0, time_base_s * time_growth ** (target_level - 1) / speed); extend `unit_defense(unit, tribe, cfg, upgrade_level: int = 0)` so BOTH values are multiplied by upgrade_multiplier(upgrade_level, cfg) (default 0 keeps old results).
== realm/core/combat.py ==
`ArmyGroup` gets a new field `upgrades: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)` (unit -> upgrade level, AFTER the existing fields); attack sums (A_inf/A_cav) multiply each unit's attack by units.upgrade_multiplier(group.upgrades.get(unit, 0), cfg) for the attacker group; defense sums pass the group's upgrade level of that unit to unit_defense. Everything else unchanged.
== realm/services/views.py ==
Add `UpgradeOption(BaseModel)`: unit: str; name_th: str; level: int; target_level: int | None; cost: dict[str, float] | None; time_s: float | None; missing: list[str]; affordable: bool; finishes_at: datetime | None.
== realm/services/smithy.py (new) ==
`effective_levels(s, village_id, now) -> dict[str, int]`: for every UnitUpgrade row of the village: level + 1 when upgrading_to is not None and finishes_at <= now (and upgrading_to == level + 1), else level; only units with level > 0 are included. `finalize(s, village_id, now) -> None` persists finished upgrades (level = upgrading_to, upgrading_to/finishes_at = None). `start_upgrade(s, player_id, village_id, unit, now, cfg) -> UnitUpgrade`: villages.lock_village, owner check (GameError FORBIDDEN, message villages.FORBIDDEN_TH), villages.settle_village, finalize; unit unknown or not upgradable -> INVALID_UNITS 'ไม่พบหน่วยนี้' ; smithy level (villages.levels) < 1 -> REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET f'ต้องมี {name_th of smithy} เลเวล 1'; any UnitUpgrade row of this village still upgrading (finishes_at > now) -> QUEUE_FULL 'กำลังอัปเกรดอยู่'; target = current level + 1 > min(cfg.upgrades.max_level, smithy level) -> MAX_LEVEL 'อัปเกรดถึงเลเวลสูงสุดแล้ว'; cost = units.upgrade_cost(unit, player.tribe, target, cfg), stock must cover it else INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES (villages.INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES_TH); deduct the cost; upsert the row (create with level 0 when missing) setting upgrading_to = target and finishes_at = now + upgrade_time_s(target, world.speed, cfg); villages.after_change; notify.notify(..., 'village', village id); return the row. `get_upgrade_options(s, player_id, village_id, now, cfg) -> list[UpgradeOption]`: lock + owner check + settle + finalize; one option per upgradable unit in YAML order: level = effective level, target_level = level + 1 or None when at the cap min(max_level, smithy level) (or smithy level 0), cost/time_s of the next level (None when no target), missing = [] or the smithy requirement message, affordable = stock covers cost and no missing and no upgrade running, finishes_at = the running upgrade's finishes_at for that unit else None.
== realm/services/military.py (small Edits in the battle code only) ==
Where the attacker ArmyGroup is built in `_resolve_battle_arrival` pass `upgrades=smithy.effective_levels(s, m.from_village_id, now)`; in `_defender_groups` (add a `now` parameter and update its callers) give each defender group `upgrades=smithy.effective_levels(s, home_id, now)`.
== Tests ==
tests/core/test_upgrades.py (pure, load_config): upgrade_multiplier(0)=1.0, (10)=1.15, (20)=1.3; upgrade_cost('spearman','stonehold',1) == Res(700,500,300,500); level 2 == Res(910,650,390,650); ironwild spearman level 1 == Res(560,400,240,400) and level 3 == Res(946,676,405,676) (560*1.69=946.4, 400*1.69=676, 240*1.69=405.6, 400*1.69=676); upgrade_time_s(1,1)=1800.0, (2,1)=2160.0, (1,10)=180.0, minimum 1.0; unit_defense('spearman','stonehold',cfg,10) == (46.2875, 66.125) (35*1.15*1.15, 50*1.15*1.15; use pytest.approx) and the default level 0 unchanged (40.25, 57.5); can_upgrade true for spearman, light_cavalry, ram and false for scout, chief, settler; combat: 100 stonehold spearmen with upgrade level 10 defending against 50 light_cavalry (ironwild attacker, empty wall, defender tribe stonehold): defense_power == 100*66.125 + 10 = 6622.5; attacker light_cavalry upgrade level 20: attack_power == 50*60*1.3 = 3900.0 (pytest.approx).
tests/services/test_smithy.py (DB fixtures `s`, `cfg`, `t0`; world = worlds.create_world(s, seed=1, speed=1, player_name='ผู้เล่น', tribe='stonehold', bot_count=2, cfg=cfg, real_now=t0); A = the human village; Building smithy level 1 inserted at center slot 21): start_upgrade('spearman') at t0 -> row upgrading_to 1, finishes_at t0+1800 s, stock (50, 250, 450, 250) (750 minus 700/500/300/500); effective_levels at t0 == {} and at t0+1800 s == {'spearman': 1}; a second start at t0+10 s -> QUEUE_FULL; after completion (now t0+1800 s) a second level with smithy level 1 -> MAX_LEVEL; with smithy level 2 it succeeds: cost (910,650,390,650) needs stock (refill the stock first), finishes_at now+2160 s; unit 'scout' or unknown -> INVALID_UNITS; without a smithy -> REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET; stock 0 -> INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES and nothing changes; other player -> FORBIDDEN; get_upgrade_options returns 6 options (spearman, swordsman, light_cavalry, heavy_cavalry, ram, catapult), the spearman option shows level 0, target 1, cost {'wood':700,'stone':500,'iron':300,'food':500}, time_s 1800.0, affordable True with a full stock; the running upgrade shows finishes_at and everything unaffordable. Integration: Movement attack bot 1 (tribe 'ironwild') -> human village A with units {'light_cavalry': 50} from B where UnitUpgrade(B, 'light_cavalry', level 20) and A has 100 spearmen (Troop home=A, location=A) with UnitUpgrade(A, 'spearman', level 10) (A's owner tribe stonehold): resolve_arrival gives report data attack_power 3900.0 and defense_power 6622.5 and the defender wins.
notes:
- Thai strings: use ONLY these (copy letter by letter; proofread): 'ไม่พบหน่วยนี้', 'กำลังอัปเกรดอยู่', 'อัปเกรดถึงเลเวลสูงสุดแล้ว' and the f-string 'ต้องมี {name_th} เลเวล 1'. Do not retype any other Thai in the existing files.
- Real columns only in tests (UnitUpgrade, Building, Troop, Village.wood/...). Settle stock via direct assignment of village.wood etc. and res_updated_at = t0.
- Never commit; never call datetime.now(). Lock order: ascending village id.
- The existing tests must keep passing (unit_defense default argument keeps old behaviour; ArmyGroup upgrades default empty).
